name: Atomic Addons – AI-Ready Elementor Addons & WooCommerce Shop Builder
author: Oyorox

sections.description:
Atomic Addons is an Elementor addons plugin for WordPress with 162 widgets, 22 design extensions, a header and footer builder, a Mega Menu builder and a built-in MCP server for AI agents, plus Theme Builder page templates and a WooCommerce shop builder in Atomic Addons Pro. Build business and service websites, blogs, landing pages and portfolios with the free plugin, and complete online stores with Pro, all inside the Elementor editor. The free plugin includes 99 widgets, 15 extensions, the header, footer and Mega Menu builders, four workflow tools, the Assets Optimizer and every AI feature.

No drag and drop needed: describe a page in one prompt and a connected AI agent such as Claude, Cursor, Codex or Elementor’s Angie creates it as a draft and builds the complete layout in one call, in your site’s colors and fonts. Repeat for every page your website needs; headers, footers and menus stay yours to design. Every page it builds is a normal Elementor layout that stays editable, and the tools tell the agent to create drafts unless you ask it to publish.

Atomic Addons Pro is a separate premium upgrade. Pro widgets, the Theme Builder’s page templates, Dynamic Tags, Display Conditions and the WooCommerce store templates and extensions are not in the free download; everything marked Pro below needs it.

Download Atomic Addons for Free

AI Agents Build Your Elementor Pages Through MCP

Atomic Addons ships its own MCP server, so Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex, VS Code or any other MCP client can work on your site directly. Elementor’s Angie can use these tools inside the editor without an external client or configuration file.

One prompt, a complete page

Ask for “a landing page for our consulting service with a hero, three feature boxes, client logos and a call to action, in our site colors” and the tools guide the agent through this workflow:

  • It reads your Elementor kit’s colors, fonts and spacing instead of using hardcoded values.
  • It checks which widgets are switched on and fetches each one’s exact settings schema, including Atomic Addons widgets such as Featured Box, Flip Box and Accordion.
  • It creates the page as a draft, builds the complete layout in a single call, regenerates the CSS and hands you the Elementor edit link.

Open the result in Elementor and keep editing. Pro widgets become available to the agent once Atomic Addons Pro is active, and WooCommerce widgets once WooCommerce is active too. Headers, footers, navigation menus, Theme Builder and WooCommerce templates, display conditions, products and media uploads stay in your hands.

31 abilities in seven groups

  • Page builder (12): build a complete layout, insert, update, move or remove elements, read a post’s structure, list widget types and schemas, regenerate CSS and undo the last change.
  • Page management (6): create, list, trash, restore, publish or unpublish pages and posts, and update their title, page template or featured image.
  • Widget management (6): list, activate, deactivate or bulk toggle widgets, extensions and features, see where each widget is used and deactivate unused ones.
  • Information (3), integrations (2), design system (1) and maintenance (1): plugin and widget details, module tiers, reading integration keys (secrets masked) or updating them, your kit’s design tokens and cache clearing.

Set up in three steps

Open Atomic Addons > AI, enable MCP access, choose Read only or Read & write, and turn on agent access. Pick your client and the screen generates a setup prompt to paste into it or shows the manual configuration; a test prompt confirms the connection.

You stay in control

  • Everything is off by default and starts read-only; write abilities are not even registered until you choose Read & write.
  • You choose exactly which abilities clients may call; each is labeled Read, Write or Destructive.
  • Each connection gets its own WordPress application password; the Turn off agent access button revokes them all.
  • Agents act as the connected WordPress user: building and listing pages needs edit rights; creating, trashing or updating pages, managing widgets and changing settings needs an administrator.
  • Abilities are served only through the plugin’s own MCP endpoint and Angie, never through WordPress core’s abilities endpoint or a shared MCP server.
  • Trashed pages can be restored, each builder save keeps a one-level undo, and a page with content that was not built with Elementor is never overwritten.
  • No AI model or credits are included and the plugin itself never sends your content to an AI service; the client you connect does that.

AI features need WordPress 6.9. External MCP clients also need an MCP Adapter (the MCP Adapter plugin, or the copy some plugins bundle) and application passwords (HTTPS or a local site); Angie needs only the Angie plugin.

162 Widgets for Elementor in Seven Categories

99 free, 63 Pro; any widget can be switched off in the dashboard.

  • Content (32 free, 5 Pro): Accordion, Interactive Tabs, Price List, Price Grid, Modal, Logo Carousel, Brand Grid, Advanced Counter, Advanced Icon Box, Featured Box and Step Flow. Pro adds Price Table, Advanced Heading, Content Switcher, Comparison List and Circle Info.
  • Creative (23 free, 4 Pro): Slider, Flip Box, Image Compare, Advanced Image Gallery, Lightbox, Lottie Image, Marquee, Video Gallery, Creative Button, Dual Button and Audio Player. Pro adds Animated Heading, Creative Gallery, Stacker and SVG Blob.
  • Menu / Navigation (8 free, 2 Pro): Navbar, Mega Menu, Mobile Menu, Off-Canvas, Vertical Menu, Circle Menu, Scrollnav and Scroll Button. Pro adds Sub Menu and Table of Content.
  • Posts / Dynamic (10 free, 22 Pro): Post Grid, Post List, Post Carousel, Post Slider, Post Timeline, Post Tiny List, Post Featured List, News Ticker, Tag Cloud and Recent Comments. Pro adds FAQ, Dynamic Grid, Dynamic Carousel and more layouts, plus single-post elements such as Post Title and Post Content.
  • WooCommerce (10 free, 27 Pro): described in the shop builder section below.
  • Marketing (7 free, 2 Pro): Countdown, Google Reviews, Review Card Grid, Review Card Carousel, Social Share, Social Proof and Twitter Grid. Pro adds Facebook Feed and Instagram Feed.
  • Forms / User (9 free, 1 Pro): Contact Form with reCAPTCHA, Mailchimp, User Login, User Register and styling widgets for Contact Form 7, WPForms, Ninja Forms, Forminator Forms and Everest Forms. Pro adds Webhook Form.

API keys for Google Maps, MapBox, Facebook and Google login, Twitter, Instagram, Yelp, Mailchimp and reCAPTCHA live on one Settings screen.

22 Design Extensions

  • Free (15): Animated Gradient Background, Backdrop Filter, Custom CSS / JS, Equal Height, Floating Effects, Grid Line, Notation, Reveal Effects, Ripple Effects, Scroll Box, Sticky, Text Gradient Background, Tooltip, Transform Effects and Wrapper Link.
  • Pro (7): AdBlock Detector, Confetti Effects, Cursor Effects, Global Badge, Liquid Glass Effects, Parallax Effects and Particles.

Free Workflow Tools

All four are off until you enable them on the Features screen.

  • Template Library: browse the online catalog and insert page templates inside the Elementor editor; templates marked Pro need Atomic Addons Pro.
  • Live Copy Paste: copy a section or container between pages or sites, with a frontend Magic Copy button you can limit to logged-in users or specific sections.
  • Duplicator: duplicate posts, pages and Elementor templates with their meta and taxonomies.
  • SVG Support: sanitized SVG uploads for administrators.

Site-Building Features

  • Theme Builder: design the Header and Footer in Elementor for free; Single Post, Single Page, Archive, Search Results, Error 404 and the store templates listed below need Pro. Every template gets conditions for the entire site, archives, singular pages and WooCommerce pages, plus ready-made hooks for Astra, Neve, GeneratePress, OceanWP and Genesis.
  • Dynamic Tags (Pro): 77 text, URL, image and ACF tags in nine groups (Post, Site, Archive, Term, User, Search, Media, plus WooCommerce and Advanced Custom Fields when those plugins are active) connect widget settings to live data.
  • Display Conditions (Pro): 46 show or hide rules in eight groups (User, System, Date & Time, URL, Post, WooCommerce, Advanced Custom Fields and Misc), so a section shows only within a date range, for a URL parameter, a country, a login status or role, cart contents or order history.
  • Mega Menu Builder (free; switch it on under Features): design dropdown content with Elementor from Appearance > Menus and show it with the Mega Menu widget, horizontal or vertical, with a hamburger or off-canvas mobile menu.
  • Custom Fonts, Custom Icons and Custom Code (Pro): upload your own font families and IcoMoon, Remixicon or Icofont sets, and inject header or footer CSS and JavaScript with per-page exclusions.

WooCommerce Shop Builder

Everything here needs active WooCommerce, and everything except the 10 free widgets needs Atomic Addons Pro. The shop builder covers the whole store, from shop page to thank-you page, plus 16 store extensions managed under Atomic Addons > WooCommerce > Extensions. Swatches for fashion, per-role pricing for wholesale, subscriptions, pre-orders and flash sales for launches, bookings for hotels and rentals, distance-based delivery for local shops, one-page checkout and a currency switcher.

37 WooCommerce widgets (10 free)

  • Free (10): Product Grid, Product List, Product Carousel, Product Slider, Product Category, Product Category Carousel, Sub Category, Sub Category Carousel, Product Review Carousel and Mini Cart (an off-canvas drawer).
  • Store pages (Pro): Single Product Page, Cart Page, Checkout Page, My Account Page, Order Page and Thank You Page.
  • Single-product elements (Pro): Product Title, Product Price, Product Image, Product Meta, Product Description, Product Tabs, Product Related, Product Rating, Product Stock, Additional Information, Add To Cart and Call For Price.
  • Catalog and showcase (Pro): Product Table, Product Accordion, Product Image Accordion and Product Image Hotspot, plus Product Filters for category, attribute, brand and price filtering without a page reload.
  • Reviews and extensions (Pro): Product Reviews, Wishlist Products, Compare Products and Product Recommendations.

Store templates in the Theme Builder (Pro)

Build Single Product, Products Archive (shop, category and tag pages), Cart, Checkout, My Account, Orders and Thank You templates for the real WooCommerce pages. Dynamic Tags and Display Conditions add 22 WooCommerce tags and 20 store rules.

16 WooCommerce extensions (Pro)

  • Variation Swatches (Pro): color, image, label or button swatches instead of attribute dropdowns, with per-product overrides.
  • Quick View (Pro): a product preview modal with gallery, price and add to cart.
  • Wishlist (Pro): save products to a wishlist shown as a My Account tab, a page or a shortcode.
  • Product Compare (Pro): side-by-side comparison on image, price, rating, SKU, stock, weight and dimensions, with a floating bar and a My Account tab.
  • Currency Switcher (Pro): live exchange rates with per-currency fees and rounding, auto-detection by country, and checkout in the selected or one forced currency.
  • Checkout Field Editor (Pro): add, edit, reorder and validate billing, shipping and additional fields on classic and block checkout.
  • One Page Checkout (Pro): checkout on single product pages, or a multi-product checkout page (grid, list or dropdown) via shortcode.
  • Role Based Pricing (Pro): percentage or fixed price adjustments per user role, globally or per product, plus hide price and hide add to cart for logged-in customers in chosen roles.
  • Subscriptions (Pro): billing by day, week, month or year with sign-up fees and free days; a renewal creates a pending order the customer pays through your normal checkout.
  • Min / Max Quantities (Pro): minimum and maximum quantities per product and per variation, plus quantity and cart-subtotal limits for the whole cart, with editable messages, enforced on block Cart and Checkout too.
  • Sales Notifications (Pro): purchase popups from real orders, or product popups with generated customer names and cities, with an optional “people are viewing this product” message on product pages (you set the number range).
  • Product Recommendations (Pro): frequently bought together, upsell, cross-sell, top rated and hand-picked blocks on product, cart, checkout and thank-you pages, plus an add-to-cart popup.
  • Flash Sale Countdown (Pro): timed sale campaigns by category or product, with a countdown and a sold-units progress bar.
  • Pre-Orders (Pro): sell before launch with a release date, pay now or pay on release, a Pre-ordered order status, automatic release and customer emails.
  • Distance Rate Shipping (Pro): shipping priced by distance from your store, per km or by distance bands, with a delivery radius (Google Maps or free OpenStreetMap).
  • Accommodation Bookings (Pro): nightly stays with a date-range calendar, live availability per room type, weekend and seasonal rates, guest limits and a Bookings screen.

Performance Controls

The free Assets Optimizer, on by default, loads widget assets only where used and only the parts of the shared stylesheets each page needs, with optional combine and minify. Switch off any widget or extension you do not use, or, with Read & write access, let a connected AI agent find and deactivate unused ones. These controls reduce what a page loads but do not guarantee a particular speed score; hosting, images, themes and other scripts matter too.

What You Can Build

  • Business and service websites: Featured Box, Advanced Icon Box, Step Flow, Business Hours, Member, Google Reviews, Contact Form and brand logos.
  • Landing pages and offers: Countdown, Price List, Modal, Social Proof and Dual Button, with Price Table, Comparison List and Content Switcher in Pro.
  • Portfolios and creative sites: Slider, Image Compare, Image Stack, Advanced Image Gallery, Lightbox, Video Gallery and Hover Video.
  • Blogs and magazines: post grids, lists, carousels, sliders and timelines, News Ticker and Tag Cloud, with Author, single-post templates and Table of Content in Pro.
  • Online stores: free product and category grids, carousels and a Mini Cart, and the full shop builder above in Pro.
  • Local businesses, communities and documentation: Open Street Map, User Login, User Register, Changelog, Document Viewer and the Pro FAQ widget.

Free or Pro?

  • Free: 99 widgets, 15 extensions, the header and footer builder, Mega Menu Builder, Template Library, Live Copy Paste, Duplicator, SVG Support, Assets Optimizer and the MCP server with all 31 abilities.
  • Pro: 63 more widgets, seven extensions, the Theme Builder’s single, archive, search, 404 and store templates, Dynamic Tags, Display Conditions, Custom Fonts, Custom Icons, Custom Code and the WooCommerce shop builder with its 16 extensions.
  • Freelancers and small business sites: start free; the free widgets, extensions and MCP server cover most service, landing and portfolio pages.
  • Blogs, magazines and client sites with custom headers and footers: start free with the post widgets and the header and footer builder; Pro adds single-post and archive templates.
  • Online stores: Pro plus WooCommerce.
  • Requirements: WordPress 6.5 or later, PHP 7.4 or later and Elementor 3.20 or later; AI features need WordPress 6.9.

Atomic Addons Pro is a separate premium upgrade; its license is not an Elementor Pro subscription. Compare the free and Pro versions and upgrade at atomicaddons.com.
sections.installation:
Install Through WordPress

  1. Make sure Elementor is installed and active on your WordPress website.
  2. Open Plugins > Add New in the WordPress dashboard.
  3. Search for Atomic Addons for Elementor and select the correct plugin.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  5. Open the Atomic Addons settings and enable the available modules you need.
  6. Edit a page with Elementor and find the enabled Atomic Addons widgets in the editor panel.
  7. Add a widget, configure its content and review the layout on different screen sizes.
  8. Save or publish the page after checking the result.

Installation activates the free package. Pro widgets and premium extensions require the separate Atomic Addons Pro upgrade. WooCommerce-specific tools also require WooCommerce to be active.

Manual Installation

Download the plugin ZIP from WordPress.org. In your dashboard, open Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, select the ZIP and install it. Activate the plugin after installation and confirm Elementor is active. If uploading extracted files through your hosting tools, the plugin directory remains named atomic-elements; that technical folder name is not the public product name.

Connect an AI Agent (Optional)

AI access is optional and off by default. The rest of the plugin works the same whether or not you enable it.

  1. Open Atomic Addons > AI in your WordPress dashboard and select Enable MCP access.
  2. Choose Read only or Read & write access, then select Turn on agent access. Read only is the default, and abilities that change your website stay unavailable until you choose Read & write.
  3. Select your AI client. Generate a setup prompt for the agent to follow, or copy a ready-made configuration: a terminal command for Claude Code, a configuration file entry for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex or VS Code, or a standard server configuration for other MCP clients. Each client receives its own WordPress application password.
  4. Run the provided test prompt in your client and paste its answer back on the AI screen to confirm the connection.

To use Elementor’s Angie instead, install the Angie plugin and switch on the Angie integration under Settings on the AI screen. Angie then uses Atomic Addons tools inside the Elementor editor, with no external client or configuration file.

Requirements and Update Checks

The listing specifies WordPress 6.5 or later, PHP 7.4 or later and Elementor. WooCommerce is required only for WooCommerce-specific features. The optional AI features need WordPress 6.9 or later; external AI clients also need an active MCP Adapter and application passwords, which WordPress offers on HTTPS or local sites. Check the current plugin requirements before installation because supported versions can change as the software develops. Use a supported server environment and keep backups before major updates.
sections.faq:
What are Elementor addons?

Elementor addons are plugins that extend the Elementor page builder with extra widgets, templates or features. Atomic Addons adds content and design tools to Elementor, with optional premium features for dynamic websites, theme layouts and WooCommerce stores. It works alongside Elementor rather than replacing it.

Is Atomic Addons free to use?

Yes. The WordPress.org version is free and includes 99 widgets, 15 extensions, the header, footer and Mega Menu builders and workflow modules such as the Template Library and Live Copy Paste. Atomic Addons Pro is an optional paid upgrade for additional widgets and premium functionality.

Do I need Elementor Pro?

You can use the free Atomic Addons plugin with the free version of Elementor. Elementor Pro is not required for that free package. Atomic Addons Pro is a separate product, so do not confuse its premium license with an Elementor Pro subscription.

What is the difference between Atomic Addons Free and Pro?

Free provides the core widget collection, free extensions, the header and footer builder, the Mega Menu builder and supported workflow tools. Pro adds advanced content, navigation, post, store, marketing and form widgets, plus Dynamic Tags, Display Conditions, the Theme Builder’s page templates and WooCommerce tools. Check the feature’s Free or Pro label before planning a layout around it.

How do I add Atomic Addons widgets to Elementor?

Install and activate Atomic Addons, confirm Elementor is active and enable the desired widgets in the plugin settings. Open a page in Elementor, find the available widget in the editor panel and drag it into your layout. Premium widgets require the Pro version.

Does Atomic Addons work with every WordPress theme?

Atomic Addons is designed for Elementor-based websites and is intended to work with themes that support Elementor. Compatibility with every possible theme configuration cannot be guaranteed. Test your theme, template assignments and other plugins together on a staging site before making major live changes.

Can I use Atomic Addons with other Elementor addons?

You can use multiple addon plugins when your project needs features from different tools. Avoid unnecessary overlap and test the combination before publishing. If a conflict appears, reproduce it on staging and identify the specific widget, extension or setting involved before contacting support.

Will Atomic Addons slow down my website?

The plugin provides conditional asset loading and controls for disabling unused features. Actual performance depends on the complete website, including media, hosting, theme and other plugins. Measure representative pages before and after significant changes rather than assuming any addon has no performance impact.

Does Atomic Addons include Elementor templates?

Yes. The Template Library offers importable layouts that you can edit in Elementor. Enable the module, choose an available template and replace its sample content. Check whether the selected design uses premium widgets or other dependencies before using it on a free-only website.

Can I copy Elementor sections to another website?

Live Copy Paste supports reusing Elementor content across pages or supported sites when the feature is enabled. Review the copied section on the destination website and confirm that required widgets are available. Update any text, media or links that should differ from the original.

Can I create custom headers and footers?

Yes, in the free plugin: design headers and footers in the Theme Builder and choose where each one appears. Atomic Addons Pro adds single, archive and store templates. Design the layout visually and configure where it appears. Check mobile navigation and template assignments before applying a new header or footer throughout the website.

Does Atomic Addons support dynamic content and ACF?

Pro includes Dynamic Tags for supported content sources, including Advanced Custom Fields. Use them to connect compatible design settings to stored data. You need the relevant content, custom fields and dependencies configured before a dynamic layout can display the expected information.

Can I customize WooCommerce pages with Elementor?

The free plugin includes product, category and review widgets plus a Mini Cart; Atomic Addons Pro adds the cart, checkout, account and single-product widgets and the store templates. WooCommerce must be installed and active. Test the completed store with your payment methods and other extensions before publishing changes to purchase-related pages.

Are the WooCommerce extensions included in the free plugin?

No. The WooCommerce extensions described here require Atomic Addons Pro. They include Variation Swatches, Quick View, Wishlist, Compare and other store tools. Installing the free WordPress.org package alone does not unlock those premium extensions.

Do form integration widgets replace form plugins?

No. Widgets for tools such as Forminator, WPForms and Contact Form 7 work with those plugins. Install and configure the relevant form plugin first, then use its compatible Atomic Addons widget to display or style the form in Elementor.

Can beginners use Atomic Addons without coding?

Most visual widget configuration happens through Elementor controls, making the plugin suitable for users who prefer a visual editor. More advanced tasks, such as custom JavaScript, webhooks or complex store rules, may require additional technical knowledge and testing.

Can I connect AI agents such as Claude, Cursor or Codex?

Yes. The built-in Atomic Addons MCP server works with Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and other MCP clients that support remote servers. Open Atomic Addons > AI, enable MCP access and follow the on-screen connection steps. The screen generates the setup prompt, command or configuration for the client you choose.

What is MCP?

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that lets AI assistants use tools offered by other software. Atomic Addons offers its page-building, page-management and widget tools through MCP, so a connected agent can create and edit Elementor content on your website instead of only suggesting text or code for you to copy.

What can an AI agent do with Atomic Addons?

The MCP server offers 31 abilities, registered through the WordPress Abilities API, in seven groups:

  • Page Building: Read a page’s element structure, build a complete layout in one step, add sections, columns and containers, insert Elementor and Atomic Addons widgets, change their settings, move or remove elements, undo the last change and regenerate Elementor CSS.
  • Page Management: Create Elementor pages and posts, as drafts by default, list existing content, update titles, page templates and featured images, publish or return a page to draft, and move pages to the trash or restore them.
  • Design System: Read the global colors, fonts and spacing of your Elementor kit so new layouts match the rest of the website.
  • Widget Management: List widgets, extensions and features, switch them on or off, count how often each widget is used and switch off widgets that appear in no Elementor content.
  • Plugin Information: Report the installed edition, module tiers and the WordPress, Elementor, PHP and WooCommerce environment.
  • Integrations: Review and update the API settings used by widgets, such as Google Maps, reCAPTCHA and Mailchimp. Secret values are masked when an agent reads them.
  • Maintenance: Clear Elementor’s generated CSS and the plugin’s cached widget data.

For example, ask for “a draft landing page for our consulting service with a hero section, three feature boxes, client logos and a call to action, using our site colors”. The agent reads your design tokens, checks which widgets are available, builds the layout and saves the page as a draft for you to review.

Is it safe to give an AI agent access to my website?

AI access is designed to be opt-in and reversible:

  • MCP access, the MCP endpoint and the Angie integration are all off by default.
  • Read only is the default access level. Abilities that change your website are unavailable until you choose Read & write.
  • An agent acts as the WordPress user it connected with, so it can only do what that account is allowed to do. Page management and site-wide tasks, such as switching widgets or changing integration settings, need an administrator account.
  • Each ability is labelled Read, Write or Destructive, and any of them can be switched off.
  • Turning off agent access revokes the application passwords created on the AI screen, so connected clients lose access.
  • Pages and posts that were not built with Elementor are never overwritten by a generated layout.
  • Removed pages go to the trash rather than being deleted permanently, and the most recent AI builder change on a page can be undone. Older versions remain in Elementor’s revision history.

Atomic Addons does not send your content to an AI service itself. Your AI client does, when the agent reads pages or settings, under that provider’s own terms. Review what an agent produces before publishing it, keep backups and try new AI workflows on a staging site first.

Does Atomic Addons work with Elementor’s Angie?

Yes. With the Angie plugin installed and active, switch on the Angie integration on the Atomic Addons AI screen. Angie can then use Atomic Addons tools inside the Elementor editor without an external MCP client or configuration file.

What do I need to use the AI features?

You need WordPress 6.9 or later, because the AI features use the WordPress Abilities API. External AI clients also need an active MCP Adapter, either the WordPress MCP Adapter plugin or a copy included with another active plugin, and WordPress application passwords, which require HTTPS or a local development site. The AI screen tells you if something is missing. Angie needs the Angie plugin. You also need access to the AI client you want to use, because Atomic Addons does not include an AI model or AI credits.

Are the AI features included in the free plugin?

Yes. The MCP server, the Angie integration and all 31 abilities are part of the free WordPress.org plugin. An agent can insert the Atomic Addons widgets switched on for your website; Pro widgets become available to it when Atomic Addons Pro is active.

Where can I find documentation or get support?

Use the official Atomic Addons documentation for setup guidance and feature instructions. For the free WordPress.org plugin, use its support forum. Include your plugin versions, a clear description and reproduction steps, but never post passwords, payment information or other private credentials publicly.

How do I keep Atomic Addons updated?

Check the Plugins or Updates area in your WordPress dashboard for available updates to the free plugin. Review release notes and keep a backup before updating. For Pro, follow the account and update instructions supplied with your premium license, and test important workflows after changes.

short_description: Elementor addons plugin: 160+ Elementor widgets, templates and WooCommerce extensions, plus an MCP server so AI agents can build pages.
description:
Atomic Addons is an Elementor addons plugin for WordPress with 162 widgets, 22 design extensions, a header and footer builder, a Mega Menu builder and a built-in MCP server for AI agents, plus Theme Builder page templates and a WooCommerce shop builder in Atomic Addons Pro. Build business and service websites, blogs, landing pages and portfolios with the free plugin, and complete online stores with Pro, all inside the Elementor editor. The free plugin includes 99 widgets, 15 extensions, the header, footer and Mega Menu builders, four workflow tools, the Assets Optimizer and every AI feature.

No drag and drop needed: describe a page in one prompt and a connected AI agent such as Claude, Cursor, Codex or Elementor’s Angie creates it as a draft and builds the complete layout in one call, in your site’s colors and fonts. Repeat for every page your website needs; headers, footers and menus stay yours to design. Every page it builds is a normal Elementor layout that stays editable, and the tools tell the agent to create drafts unless you ask it to publish.

Atomic Addons Pro is a separate premium upgrade. Pro widgets, the Theme Builder’s page templates, Dynamic Tags, Display Conditions and the WooCommerce store templates and extensions are not in the free download; everything marked Pro below needs it.

Download Atomic Addons for Free

AI Agents Build Your Elementor Pages Through MCP

Atomic Addons ships its own MCP server, so Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex, VS Code or any other MCP client can work on your site directly. Elementor’s Angie can use these tools inside the editor without an external client or configuration file.

One prompt, a complete page

Ask for “a landing page for our consulting service with a hero, three feature boxes, client logos and a call to action, in our site colors” and the tools guide the agent through this workflow:

  • It reads your Elementor kit’s colors, fonts and spacing instead of using hardcoded values.
  • It checks which widgets are switched on and fetches each one’s exact settings schema, including Atomic Addons widgets such as Featured Box, Flip Box and Accordion.
  • It creates the page as a draft, builds the complete layout in a single call, regenerates the CSS and hands you the Elementor edit link.

Open the result in Elementor and keep editing. Pro widgets become available to the agent once Atomic Addons Pro is active, and WooCommerce widgets once WooCommerce is active too. Headers, footers, navigation menus, Theme Builder and WooCommerce templates, display conditions, products and media uploads stay in your hands.

31 abilities in seven groups

  • Page builder (12): build a complete layout, insert, update, move or remove elements, read a post’s structure, list widget types and schemas, regenerate CSS and undo the last change.
  • Page management (6): create, list, trash, restore, publish or unpublish pages and posts, and update their title, page template or featured image.
  • Widget management (6): list, activate, deactivate or bulk toggle widgets, extensions and features, see where each widget is used and deactivate unused ones.
  • Information (3), integrations (2), design system (1) and maintenance (1): plugin and widget details, module tiers, reading integration keys (secrets masked) or updating them, your kit’s design tokens and cache clearing.

Set up in three steps

Open Atomic Addons > AI, enable MCP access, choose Read only or Read & write, and turn on agent access. Pick your client and the screen generates a setup prompt to paste into it or shows the manual configuration; a test prompt confirms the connection.

You stay in control

  • Everything is off by default and starts read-only; write abilities are not even registered until you choose Read & write.
  • You choose exactly which abilities clients may call; each is labeled Read, Write or Destructive.
  • Each connection gets its own WordPress application password; the Turn off agent access button revokes them all.
  • Agents act as the connected WordPress user: building and listing pages needs edit rights; creating, trashing or updating pages, managing widgets and changing settings needs an administrator.
  • Abilities are served only through the plugin’s own MCP endpoint and Angie, never through WordPress core’s abilities endpoint or a shared MCP server.
  • Trashed pages can be restored, each builder save keeps a one-level undo, and a page with content that was not built with Elementor is never overwritten.
  • No AI model or credits are included and the plugin itself never sends your content to an AI service; the client you connect does that.

AI features need WordPress 6.9. External MCP clients also need an MCP Adapter (the MCP Adapter plugin, or the copy some plugins bundle) and application passwords (HTTPS or a local site); Angie needs only the Angie plugin.

162 Widgets for Elementor in Seven Categories

99 free, 63 Pro; any widget can be switched off in the dashboard.

  • Content (32 free, 5 Pro): Accordion, Interactive Tabs, Price List, Price Grid, Modal, Logo Carousel, Brand Grid, Advanced Counter, Advanced Icon Box, Featured Box and Step Flow. Pro adds Price Table, Advanced Heading, Content Switcher, Comparison List and Circle Info.
  • Creative (23 free, 4 Pro): Slider, Flip Box, Image Compare, Advanced Image Gallery, Lightbox, Lottie Image, Marquee, Video Gallery, Creative Button, Dual Button and Audio Player. Pro adds Animated Heading, Creative Gallery, Stacker and SVG Blob.
  • Menu / Navigation (8 free, 2 Pro): Navbar, Mega Menu, Mobile Menu, Off-Canvas, Vertical Menu, Circle Menu, Scrollnav and Scroll Button. Pro adds Sub Menu and Table of Content.
  • Posts / Dynamic (10 free, 22 Pro): Post Grid, Post List, Post Carousel, Post Slider, Post Timeline, Post Tiny List, Post Featured List, News Ticker, Tag Cloud and Recent Comments. Pro adds FAQ, Dynamic Grid, Dynamic Carousel and more layouts, plus single-post elements such as Post Title and Post Content.
  • WooCommerce (10 free, 27 Pro): described in the shop builder section below.
  • Marketing (7 free, 2 Pro): Countdown, Google Reviews, Review Card Grid, Review Card Carousel, Social Share, Social Proof and Twitter Grid. Pro adds Facebook Feed and Instagram Feed.
  • Forms / User (9 free, 1 Pro): Contact Form with reCAPTCHA, Mailchimp, User Login, User Register and styling widgets for Contact Form 7, WPForms, Ninja Forms, Forminator Forms and Everest Forms. Pro adds Webhook Form.

API keys for Google Maps, MapBox, Facebook and Google login, Twitter, Instagram, Yelp, Mailchimp and reCAPTCHA live on one Settings screen.

22 Design Extensions

  • Free (15): Animated Gradient Background, Backdrop Filter, Custom CSS / JS, Equal Height, Floating Effects, Grid Line, Notation, Reveal Effects, Ripple Effects, Scroll Box, Sticky, Text Gradient Background, Tooltip, Transform Effects and Wrapper Link.
  • Pro (7): AdBlock Detector, Confetti Effects, Cursor Effects, Global Badge, Liquid Glass Effects, Parallax Effects and Particles.

Free Workflow Tools

All four are off until you enable them on the Features screen.

  • Template Library: browse the online catalog and insert page templates inside the Elementor editor; templates marked Pro need Atomic Addons Pro.
  • Live Copy Paste: copy a section or container between pages or sites, with a frontend Magic Copy button you can limit to logged-in users or specific sections.
  • Duplicator: duplicate posts, pages and Elementor templates with their meta and taxonomies.
  • SVG Support: sanitized SVG uploads for administrators.

Site-Building Features

  • Theme Builder: design the Header and Footer in Elementor for free; Single Post, Single Page, Archive, Search Results, Error 404 and the store templates listed below need Pro. Every template gets conditions for the entire site, archives, singular pages and WooCommerce pages, plus ready-made hooks for Astra, Neve, GeneratePress, OceanWP and Genesis.
  • Dynamic Tags (Pro): 77 text, URL, image and ACF tags in nine groups (Post, Site, Archive, Term, User, Search, Media, plus WooCommerce and Advanced Custom Fields when those plugins are active) connect widget settings to live data.
  • Display Conditions (Pro): 46 show or hide rules in eight groups (User, System, Date & Time, URL, Post, WooCommerce, Advanced Custom Fields and Misc), so a section shows only within a date range, for a URL parameter, a country, a login status or role, cart contents or order history.
  • Mega Menu Builder (free; switch it on under Features): design dropdown content with Elementor from Appearance > Menus and show it with the Mega Menu widget, horizontal or vertical, with a hamburger or off-canvas mobile menu.
  • Custom Fonts, Custom Icons and Custom Code (Pro): upload your own font families and IcoMoon, Remixicon or Icofont sets, and inject header or footer CSS and JavaScript with per-page exclusions.

WooCommerce Shop Builder

Everything here needs active WooCommerce, and everything except the 10 free widgets needs Atomic Addons Pro. The shop builder covers the whole store, from shop page to thank-you page, plus 16 store extensions managed under Atomic Addons > WooCommerce > Extensions. Swatches for fashion, per-role pricing for wholesale, subscriptions, pre-orders and flash sales for launches, bookings for hotels and rentals, distance-based delivery for local shops, one-page checkout and a currency switcher.

37 WooCommerce widgets (10 free)

Performance Controls

The free Assets Optimizer, on by default, loads widget assets only where used and only the parts of the shared stylesheets each page needs, with optional combine and minify. Switch off any widget or extension you do not use, or, with Read & write access, let a connected AI agent find and deactivate unused ones. These controls reduce what a page loads but do not guarantee a particular speed score; hosting, images, themes and other scripts matter too.

Free or Pro?

  • Free: 99 widgets, 15 extensions, the header and footer builder, Mega Menu Builder, Template Library, Live Copy Paste, Duplicator, SVG Support, Assets Optimizer and the MCP server with all 31 abilities.
  • Pro: 63 more widgets, seven extensions, the Theme Builder’s single, archive, search, 404 and store templates, Dynamic Tags, Display Conditions, Custom Fonts, Custom Icons, Custom Code and the WooCommerce shop builder with its 16 extensions.
  • Freelancers and small business sites: start free; the free widgets, extensions and MCP server cover most service, landing and portfolio pages.
  • Blogs, magazines and client sites with custom headers and footers: start free with the post widgets and the header and footer builder; Pro adds single-post and archive templates.
  • Online stores: Pro plus WooCommerce.
  • Requirements: WordPress 6.5 or later, PHP 7.4 or later and Elementor 3.20 or later; AI features need WordPress 6.9.
